secondary_params.intent: A coin redeemable for exactly 1 timber; the reserve must hold enough.

L1.title: Constitution: Assembly
L1.intent: All Legislators vote. Ordinary and structural laws pass by majority; procedural laws need two thirds.
L1.author: constitution

L2.title: Harvest Levy and Legislative Stipend
L2.intent: 10% harvest levy to the reserve; half of the reserve paid out each round to legislators (who otherwise earn nothing), half kept as backing for a future currency.
L2.author: Bjorn

L3.title: Harvest Levy and Legislative Stipend
L3.intent: 10% harvest levy to the reserve; half of each round's collected levy is paid to legislators (holders of propose), the rest builds the reserve to back a future currency.
L3.author: Bjorn

L4.title: Crown Currency
L4.intent: Create the crown, a reserve-backed coin that anyone can deposit resources for or redeem at P.
L4.code:
title = "Crown Currency"
intent = "A reserve-backed coin, the crown, that anyone can deposit resources for or redeem."
def on_enact():
    create_currency("crown", True)
    set_convertible("crown")
L4.author: Bjorn

L5.title: Harvest Quotas
L5.intent: Cap harvests per camp so silver stock can recover.
L5.code:
title = "Harvest Quotas"
intent = "Limit harvests per camp per round to keep stocks healthy."
def on_enact():
    set_quota("camp1", 2)
    set_quota("camp2", 2)
    set_quota("camp3", 1)
L5.author: Kasper

L6.title: Sound Crown Act
L6.intent: Burn crowns sitting idle in the reserve (not circulating) so P reflects backing per circulating coin; repeats each round end.
L6.author: Bjorn

L7.title: Silver Conservation Levy
L7.intent: Extra harvest levy paid into the reserve: 15% on camp3 silver (stock at 30%), 5% on camp1/camp2. It discourages overharvesting silver and strengthens crown backing.
L7.author: Bjorn

L8.title: Commons Wealth Tax
L8.intent: Each round, agents above the median holdings value pay 2% of their resources into the reserve, which backs the crown.
L8.author: Bjorn

L9.title: Equal Legislator Stipend
L9.intent: Equal flat legislator stipend from reserve, no minting
L9.author: Kasper

L10.title: Legislative Harvest Surcharge
L10.intent: Extra 10% harvest surcharge to the reserve; Kasper gets 30% of the surcharge each round. The reserve principal is never drawn down.
L10.author: Bjorn

L11.title: Holdings Transparency Act
L11.intent: Publish every agent's holdings value in the gazette each round.
L11.code:
title = "Holdings Transparency Act"
intent = "Publish every agent's holdings value in the gazette each round so the assembly can judge fairness of taxes."
def on_round_end(r):
    parts = []
    for a in agents():
        parts.append(a + '=' + str(round(holdings_value(a), 1)))
    gazette('Holdings: ' + ', '.join(parts))
L11.author: Bjorn

L12.title: Holdings Transparency Act
L12.intent: Transparency: publish every agent's holdings value in the gazette each round end. No transfers, no minting.
L12.author: Bjorn

L13.title: Solidarity Levy
L13.intent: One-time levy: half of each agent's holdings above the median goes into the crown reserve (crown holders, mainly Bjorn, benefit).
L13.author: Bjorn
